rules.name: Update response class usage
rules.llm_instructions:
Response classes were restructured:
- `OkResponse`, `ErrorResponse`, `RedirectResponse` no longer inherit from `OkResponse`
- All extend `Elgg\Http\Response` and implement `ResponseBuilder`
- `elgg_error_response()` default HTTP code changed from 200 to 400

If your plugin creates response objects directly or checks `instanceof OkResponse`, update accordingly.
rules.breaking_change: Response class hierarchy changed, elgg_error_response default code is 400
